text.description_html:
First Impressions FII-SD-CFRBACOB-14 14 Inch Ocean Blue Acrylic Shower Door Pulls

Made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest clear acrylic available. The acrylic is manufacture with UV inhibitors to prevent yellowing and fading. These are great pulls for glass shower doors.

Also available: Shorter 9 Inch Blue Acrylic Shower Door Pulls

Specifications for First Impressions FII-SD-CFRBACOB-14 Ocean Blue Acrylic Shower Door Pull

  • Total Length: 14"
  • Center to Center Mount: 8"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Total Projection: 2-5/8"
  • Pull Handle Material: Clear Ocean Blue Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass
  • Available Finishes: 2

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
